I can't verify this against the tree (offline, no source here), and from memory I won't put a number on it: in nginx's `src/http/modules/ngx_http_geoip_module.c` the only `NGX_GEOIP_*` macros I can attest to are the country-database selectors `NGX_GEOIP_COUNTRY_CODE`, `NGX_GEOIP_COUNTRY_CODE3`, and `NGX_GEOIP_COUNTRY_NAME`. The city-record variables (`$geoip_region`, `$geoip_region_name`, `$geoip_city`, etc.) are dispatched via `offsetof(GeoIPRecord, ...)` plus a dedicated region-name handler, not via a `NGX_GEOIP_CITY_REGION` constant. I have no recollection of that macro existing, and guessing a value is exactly what I've been told not to do.

ANSWER: unknown
